[RESPONSE] I’ve been having trouble concentrating at work for about two months, and I’m constantly tired. I’ve also been waking up early and can’t get back to sleep. My spouse has noticed I’m speaking more slowly than usual and that I’m eating less. I’ve also lost interest in things I used to enjoy—like my dance classes.
